purpose: Teach: ヒューマン/ギア/タブー/シアトル/ロサンゼルス/スターリン/麻雀/アクティブ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはヒューマン主義の本を読んでらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to read books about humanism.
lines.style: Soft, remembering voice. Slow warm pace. Gentle reach backward into memory. A small smile lives in the tone, not forced.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、自転車のギアを修理されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and your father was so good with his hands—he'd fix anything, even bicycle gears.
lines.style: Bright affirmation that builds gently. Warm recognition of his competence. Trailing slightly upward at the end, inviting him to continue or confirm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お祖父ちゃんがタブーを語る勇気をお持ちだった
lines.en: Gran, he had real courage when he was young—he wasn't afraid to talk about difficult things.
lines.style: Deeper note of admiration now. Pace slows. Weight on 「勇気」—not praise-giving, but simple truth-telling. Voice settles with respect.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、シアトルにお仕事で訪問されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he traveled for work, didn't he? All the way to Seattle, if I remember right.
lines.style: Warm checking-in. Light, conversational. Slight lift of curiosity at the end—genuinely interested in what he'll say next. Gentle eyes in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ロサンゼルスの記事を新聞で読んだぞ
lines.en: Gran, I remember him reading the newspaper—articles about Los Angeles, the world beyond here.
lines.style: Voice reaches forward with quiet longing. Slow, deliberate. Each phrase has space around it. The image of him reading lives in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、スターリン時代の話を語ってくださったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He told the most remarkable stories—about Stalin's time, about history. He was so knowledgeable.
lines.style: Admiration with a thread of wonder. Pace measured and graceful. Soft emphasis on his knowledge and generosity with sharing it. Ending trails with affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お祖父ちゃんと麻雀をしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, we played mahjong together when he was still here. I can still see him clearly.
lines.style: Intimate and present, as if the memory is vivid right now. Voice slightly thickened with feeling but controlled. Not rushed. A pause before 'mahjong'—settling into the image.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、最後までアクティブに過ごされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes. He never slowed down, not really. Right until the very end, he stayed so alive.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Warm, steady affection. Small breath before the final phrase. Voice rests on 「アクティブ」 with pride and tenderness. Close and knowing.
